about: The Workbench icons of the Hypercycles drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/hypercycles.png is the game's own light cycle (HYPER1.PCX, Hypercycles 1995, Bob Hays, GPL-3.0), cut out and fitted to 64 x 64. Hypercycles-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Hypercycles.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt.
